classification_statement: All rank4 concurrent reduced-cubic m4 squarefree special-I0/J0 coefficient-rank2 sources are empty.
proof: Full K1 basis forces P1=partial_z wedge W1 independent z. All Q(P1)=0. The complete same P2 linear operator has only three nonzero columns of rank3; hence P2 lies in the six remaining directions, all partial_z wedges independent z. P0+P1+P2 has this common factor, so rank<=2 and actual D=0 for every parameter.
